## Summary

Implements ADR 0150 first-release multi-model routing inside the existing provider-independent NativeAgentRuntime. Routing is benchmark-gated against ADR 0142 single-model evidence, preserves one AgentRun and explicit provider-independent context handoff, enforces visual capability safety, refuses silent processing-posture escalation, records sanitized route decisions, and keeps routed runs out of single-model benchmark attribution.

Adds synthetic routing-policy tests for measured specialist adoption, threshold/fallback behavior, OOM regression rejection, and visual capability fail-closed behavior.

## Validation

Requires Windows Validation and Editor Visual Validation because AI Studio routing/model-status presentation changes.
